atomicity.reason: 'disconnect the HV battery AND warn the driver' conjoins two independent obligations; either clause alone is a complete, separately testable requirement.

feasibility.reason: Isolation monitoring and contactor opening are established technology.

parent_fit.reason: Addresses a distinct part of US_HV_SAFETY: making the HV system safe and warning the driver for the isolation-fault case.

unambiguity.reason: Underspecified edge case: whether disconnection is immediate also while driving or deferred until standstill is open.
unambiguity.suggestion: State the driving-state condition for disconnection (e.g. immediately at standstill, after a safe stop while driving).

variant_consistency.reason: Gated by spelled-out bev condition, same as parent US_HV_SAFETY.

verifiability.reason: Testable in principle, but the isolation-fault threshold (e.g. ohm/V) and the reaction time are not stated.
verifiability.suggestion: Specify the isolation resistance threshold and the maximum time from detection to disconnection and warning.
